name: template-library
body: Template library: the deck's template library — one set drawn from up to two layers (library-layer): the external library at the `templates:` path in `kalide.yaml` when the key is present, and the deck-root `templates/` directory when it exists (see layered-template-library). Each layer is a self-contained, relocatable unit identified by its library manifest; the merged set holds the layers' templates, themes and media with no name carried by both (library-layer-uniqueness). The deck-root layer is an ordinary library; the external layer is self-contained and validates on its own (library-layer-references). A deck with no layer is an error (templates-dir-required), and the layers' roots are pinned for the life of a `kalide start` session: a mid-session change to the configured `templates:` value keeps the pinned external root and surfaces the full-page restart-required error (see template-retarget-requires-restart, global.constraint.never-serve-broken-deck).
